query: INSERT INTO light_state (ieee_address, state, brightness, colour_temp, colour) VALUES ($1, COALESCE($2, 'OFF'), $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (ieee_address) DO UPDATE SET state = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.state, light_state.state), brightness = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.brightness, light_state.brightness), colour_temp = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.colour_temp, light_state.colour_temp), colour = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.colour, light_state.colour) RETURNING state, brightness, colour_temp, colour
